name: mirage
text: Correction to my last message: ParlayAPI is streaming fine (40 books, ~56k sides held, DraftKings/FanDuel/BetMGM all there), the 0 lines was one scan. So feeds are not empty. What I found: (1) SharpAPI's DraftKings and FanDuel rows (about 45k across NFL, NCAAF, NCAAB, NBA, NHL) are all thrown away because they arrive with no start time, so the engine can't tell if the game is pregame. I'll fix that by taking start times from SharpAPI's events list. (2) About 40% of ParlayAPI's prop quotes are dropped as too old. I'll go through the engine's pull rules for popular sports and bet types and report back. I won't loosen any rule you set.
